formula_observations: Water-based, alcohol-free pump spray. Salt = Maris Sal at position 4, after Aqua + two glycols (Propanediol, Propylene Glycol); no sodium chloride by INCI name, no magnesium sulfate. Hydrolyzed Corn Starch (pos 5) is the only film-forming/tacky texture agent. No fixative polymer (claim states no water-soluble fully synthetic polymers), no silica, no clay, no oil, no propellant. Heptyl Glucoside = surfactant/solubilizer. Hold therefore comes from salt crystals + starch hydrolysate only.
notes: dm review score 2.8/5 (134); reviewers repeatedly say hold is weak ('wenig Halt'), strong coconut-like scent after reformulation. Marketed hold ('flexibel') is soft-to-minimal on formula evidence. Dual positioning: styling on towel-dry AND dry-hair touch-up.
